description: Deploy the Docker Example Voting App, a multi-container application with 5 services: vote (Python frontend), redis (queue), worker (.NET), db (Postgres), and result (Node.js viewer). The docker-compose.yml is at /home/ga/voting-app/. To deploy: open a terminal (right-click desktop > 'Open Terminal Here' or use Docker Desktop's integrated terminal via the Terminal button), navigate to /home/ga/voting-app/, and run 'docker compose up -d'. Alternatively, use Docker Desktop's Dev Environments feature. After deployment, verify in the Containers view that all 5 containers appear as a 'voting-app' group with green (running) status. Test the vote UI at http://localhost:5001 and results at http://localhost:5002. Dismiss any dialogs that appear.
